venue.about: Three Buddies - Burger Restaurant in Berlin bietet dir köstliche, frisch zubereitete Burger in einer entspannten Atmosphäre. Genieße unsere vielfältige Auswahl an Burgern, von klassischen Beef-Burgern bis hin zu kreativen vegetarischen und veganen Optionen. Unser freundliches Team sorgt dafür, dass du dich wohlfühlst, ob zum Mittagessen, Abendessen oder für einen Snack zwischendurch. Besuche uns im Herzen Berlins und erlebe erstklassige Burger und herzliche Gastfreundschaft. Perfekt für Familien, Freunde und alle Burger-Liebhaber.

human_steps: choose pickup or delivery (and, for delivery, an address)
open the venue's own ordering page at ordering.primary_url
pay the venue on the venue's own rail (card/paypal/cash; 3DS as the venue requires)
a human confirms the order with the venue
adapter.order_receipt: the venue's own confirmation (not machine-readable here)
adapter.payment_authority: the venue's own rail; this CVM takes no payment (ADR-0001 D5)
adapter.why_this_class: The platform DOES run an online shop for this venue, but no unauthenticated or test-mode path to place an order was found or verified: the storefront's cart and checkout are authenticated, session-bound browser flows (the capture shows Stripe/Google Pay material loaded, and clicking 'Lieferung' opens an address modal). Per ADR-0007 the honest capability set is menu+quote only, with submit/status false.

company_binding.note: The storefront payload's companies[0].id and the company payload's id differ, and BOTH answer /menus with HTTP 200. The venue's own ordering page requests /companies/550/menus (evidence/requests.json); the rendered page's prices match that payload (adapter.py --verify-rendered). This record follows the venue's own page and uses company 550.
